Module com.example.cab302_project
Package com.app.studysnap.model

Class SqliteQuizDAO

java.lang.Object
com.app.studysnap.model.SqliteQuizDAO
All Implemented Interfaces:
IQuizDAO
public class SqliteQuizDAO extends Object implements IQuizDAO
SQLite implementation of IQuizDAO.

Manages the Quizzes table (FK to Users) and delegates question persistence to SqliteQuestionDAO.
